releases.title: Executive UI Experience, Persistent Workspaces, Releases & GCP Resource Governance
releases.summary: Delivered the full-width React 19 interactive workspace with low-glare Light/Dark/System theming, business-friendly executive briefs, tab-state preservation across live analyses, an in-app Releases changelog, and the 4-layer GCP resource naming & 6-key FinOps label standard.
highlights: Full-width React 19 + d3-force interactive Contagion Explorer with ontology shapes, entity search, zoom controls, and click-to-audit SEC/OFAC/CUAD evidence.
Subtle, low-glare Light / Dark / System theme switcher with zero inline styles (strict style-src 'self' CSP compliance).
Persistent background tab state: switching between Explorer, Compare Lab, BYO Ingest, Benchmark & TCO, and Releases preserves active SSE streams, prompts, and results.

4-layer GCP Resource Attribution Standard (`acc05_` / `acc05-` naming prefix + 6 mandatory FinOps labels on BigQuery datasets/tables/jobs, Vertex AI calls, GCS metadata, dedicated `$0/mo` Model Armor template, and 1-command Cloud Asset Inventory script).
In-app Releases timeline backed by `GET /api/v1/releases` and formula-safe CSV Executive Brief export.

verification.gcp_live: BigQuery dataset acc05_enterprise_graphrag + 5 tables labeled; dedicated acc05-enterprise-graphrag-guardrail Model Armor active; live smoke GQL 1.00 path recall

releases.title: Google ADK 2.15 Autonomous Coordinator, Multimodal BYO Ingestion & Enterprise Security
releases.summary: Added multi-tool agent orchestration on Google ADK 2.15.0, customer document & custom ontology ingestion (PDF, images, CSV, TXT, YAML), Google Cloud Model Armor prompt screening, Cloud DLP PII-safe previews, and Cloud IAP ES256 JWT hardening.
highlights: Google ADK 2.15.0 LlmAgent + InMemoryRunner + BuiltInPlanner orchestrating graph traversal, chunk lookup, ontology inspection, and mandatory citation self-verification.

Multimodal BYO-Ontology /ingest pipeline: magic-byte validation (%PDF-, PNG, JPEG, UTF-8), 10 MB cap, UUID GCS keys, PyMuPDF + Gemini vision extraction, O(N) canonical entity merging, and atomic BigQuery staging MERGE.
Google Cloud Model Armor REST v1 screening + opt-in Cloud DLP inspection (include_quote=false so raw PII never enters logs or UI).

FastAPI SSE streaming API (/api/v1/query/stream, /api/v1/compare/stream, /api/v1/ingest/upload, /api/v1/tco/estimate) with strict CSP, non-wildcard CORS, sliding-window rate limits, and hardcoded ES256 IAP JWT checks.

verification.gcp_live: Live ADK 2.15 + Model Armor verified on sc_q01: 1.00 multi-hop recall, 100% self-verified citations ($0.0070)
